r448.reason: The world-space alignment clears every runtime hair layer at frame 1, but 100 complete cards contact the body across frames 20, 33 and 61.

visualFailures: The center part remains a wide flat density strip.
The top silhouette reads as parallel sheets instead of interleaved macro locks.

finding: The historical r409 runtime system is structurally portable because the 21 base-bone rest skeleton is byte-equivalent to r446. Its head-space assets require a +25.521 mm world-Y alignment. Geometry can pass collision by whole-card pruning, but this loses too much crown structure to meet the visual gate.
nextRequiredWork: Rebuild front, crown and rear macro-lock cards directly from the r446 scalp surface and open-topology head space. Preserve the seven explicit runtime layers and 15 secondary-motion bones, but resample roots and card paths instead of transplanting r409 geometry.
